findings.title: Linux GPU Driver NULL Pointer Dereference (AMD-SB-6034)
findings.summary_md: AMD's bulletin for CVE-2026-43603, a NULL pointer dereference (CWE-476, CVSS 6.9) in the AMD Linux GPU kernel driver that lets a local user crash the kernel, is dated September 8, 2026 in its revision history (day precision). It shows the actual fixes shipped weeks earlier: Radeon Software for Linux 26.13 on 2026-07-20 for Ryzen, EPYC, Athlon, and Radeon lines, and Linux GPU Driver 31.40 on 2026-07-15 for Instinct MI210 through MI355X, with EPYC Embedded and Ryzen Embedded mitigations targeted for October 2026. Credit goes to Maxime Rossi Bellom and Ramtine Tofighi Shirazi of SecMate.

findings.title: Mali GPU Driver Security Bulletin (Article ID 111552)
findings.summary_md: Arm's Mali GPU bulletin, initially released September 8, 2026 (day precision), lists ten CVE ids across the Bifrost, Valhall, and Arm 5th Gen GPU Architecture kernel and userspace drivers, mostly use-after-free and kernel information disclosure classes. CVE-2026-9034 and CVE-2026-11891 are reachable from a non-privileged process including via WebGL or WebGPU. Fixes are in r56p0 and above for Valhall and 5th Gen Architecture, while the Bifrost kernel driver (affected from r12p0 onward) has no vendor-neutral fixed version listed.

findings.title: CVE-2026-16497 (NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux)
findings.summary_md: NVD record published September 8, 2026 for an NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux flaw where excessive iteration can be triggered by an attacker, leading to denial of service. Scored CVSS 7.5 HIGH. This is the first of the two high-severity Triton defects referenced in the SecurityWeek roundup.

findings.title: CVE-2026-47625 (NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux)
findings.summary_md: NVD record published September 8, 2026 for a missing-authorization flaw in NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux whose successful exploitation can lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. Scored CVSS 7.5 HIGH. Canada's CCCS advisory AV26-900 lists affected Triton versions through the 26.03 and 26.06 trains.
